stem:
Kara owns 35 books. Of these books, 20% have fewer than 100 pages and 80% have 100 pages or more.

Complete the statement about the books Kara owns.
instruction: Move the correct answer to each box. Not all answers will be used.
response_template: Kara owns [blank_1] books with fewer than 100 pages and [blank_2] books with 100 pages or more.
